summary: Ferrari N.V. furnished a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1, its unaudited Interim Report for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IAS 34; no transaction, stakeholder action, or corporate event is described. The report contains MD&A, risk factors, outlook, and interim condensed consolidated financial statements, and lists the board (Executive Chairman John Elkann, CEO Benedetto Vigna, Vice Chairman Piero Ferrari) and auditor Deloitte Touche S.p.A. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or recommendation is stated. This is a routine periodic foreign-private-issuer earnings filing, equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q; no deal terms and no risk-arb angle apply.
